test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Foundational Full Test - 06
subject: general
question:
**Direction:** In the following question, a given question is followed by information in two statements. You have to find out the data in which statement(s) is sufficient to answer the question and mark your answer accordingly.

Among Tina, Kapil, Yash, Jam and Shiva who among them is tallest?

I. Tina is taller than Yash. Shiva is taller than Jam and Kapil.

II. Yash is smaller than Kapil.

options.text: All the statements together are not sufficient to answer.

solution:
I. Tina is taller than Yash. Shiva is taller than Jam and Kapil.

Tina > Yash and Shiva > Jam & Kapil

We cannot determine who is the tallest. Hence I alone is insufficient to answer.

II. Yash is smaller than Kapil.

Yash Tina > Kapil > Jam > Yash

Possibility 2. Tina > Shiva > Kapil > Yash > Jam

Possibility 3. Shiva > Kapil > Tina > Jam > Yash

By combining statement I and statement II we cannot answer who is the tallest.

Hence, all the statements together are not sufficient to answer the question.
